subject.title: [OAuth] Client ID revoked `app_EMoamEEZ73f0CkXaXp7hrann` - fresh ChatGPT Plus logins completely broken

question: Should OpenClaw rotate or override the OpenAI ChatGPT/Codex OAuth client ID independently, or wait for/coordinate with upstream Codex and OpenAI app ownership?
rationale: The reported client ID is still the default in current OpenClaw and upstream Codex, while replacement requires OAuth app ownership and cross-flow proof that automation cannot supply.

options.title: Coordinate OAuth app ownership
options.body: Confirm the revocation with a fresh account, coordinate a new client ID or official override with the OAuth app owner, and update both browser and device-code paths with live proof.

options.title: Add an explicit override path
options.body: Expose a documented maintainer/operator override for the client ID while keeping the upstream default until ownership is confirmed.

options.title: Close as external upstream ownership
options.body: Close only if maintainers decide OpenClaw should not carry an independent OAuth app surface for this provider path.

recommendation.title: Coordinate OAuth app ownership
recommendation.body: Confirm the revocation with a fresh account, coordinate a new client ID or official override with the OAuth app owner, and update both browser and device-code paths with live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: PR history ties steipete to the current OpenAI provider-identity and OAuth-file ownership boundary, making him the best available routing candidate from the evidence.
